description: Wasserschutzgebiete Niedersachsen und Bremen (Umrisse) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by nlwkn.niedersachsen.de. External delimitations of the water protection areas (protection and extraction areas for groundwater and drinking water (SGGW). ). Calculated layer, calculation basis Function WSG, HQSG and TWGG from Feature Class SGGWPARTZONES. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Water protection areas Lower Saxony and Bremen (outlines)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2021-01-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
